chapterInfo.content:
14
Amasia di Yuda so hene
(2 Berɛsosɛm 25.1-24)
1 # 2 Be 25.1—26.2 Israelhene Yoahas ba Yoas afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu mu na Yudahene Yoas ba Amasia bɛdii hene. 2Ɔbɛdii hene no, na wadi mfeɛ aduonu nnum, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ aduonu nkron wɔ Yerusalem. Na ne na din de Yehoadin a ɔfiri Yerusalem. 3#2 Ah 12.2-3 Na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so, nanso na ɛnte sɛ n’agya Dawid; sɛdeɛ n’agya Yoas yɛeɛ no nyinaa na ɔno nso yɛeɛ, 4#2 Ah 15.4 nanso sorɔnsorɔmmea no deɛ, wɔanyi. Ɔman no kɔɔ so bɔɔ afɔdeɛ na wɔhyee aduhwam sorɔnsorɔmmea no so. 5#2 Ah 12.20-21 Na ahennie no timm ne nsam no, ɔkumm ne nkoa a wɔkumm n’agya ɔhene no. 6#Deut 24.16 Na awudifoɔ no mma no deɛ, wanku wɔn, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ no Mose mmara no mu sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ sɛ: Wɔnnkum agyanom mma nti a, nso wɔnkum mma agyanom nti, na mmom obiara bɔne so na wɔnkum no.
7Ɔno na ɔkumm Edom mu nnipa mpemdu Nkyene-bonhwa mu, na ɔde ɔko faa Sela, na ɔtoo ne din Yokteel de bɛsi nnɛ.
8Ɛberɛ no mu na Amasia somaa abɔfoɔ maa wɔkɔɔ Israelhene Yehu ba Yehoahas ba Yehoas nkyɛn sɛ: Bra, ma yɛnsɔ yɛn ho nhwɛ. 9#Ate 9.14 Na Israelhene Yehoas soma maa wɔbaa Yudahene Amasia nkyɛn sɛ: Nkasɛɛ dua a ɛwɔ Lebanon no soma maa wɔkɔɔ tweneduro a ɛwɔ Lebanon no nkyɛn sɛ: Fa wo babaa ma me ba nware. Na wiram mmoa a wɔwɔ Lebanon no sene bɛtiatiaa nkasɛɛ dua no so. 10Kum deɛ woakum Edom, na w’akoma ama wo so. Ma w’animuonyam nnɔɔso mma wo na tena wo fie, na adɛn nti na wo ne mmusuo rebɛdi aperepereɛ na woahwe aseɛ, wo ne Yuda nyinaa?
11Na Amasia antie. Ɛnna Israelhene Yehoas foro baeɛ, na wɔbɛhyiaam koe, ɔno ne Yudahene Amasia wɔ Bet-semes a ɛyɛ Yuda dea hɔ. 12Na Yuda dii nkoguo wɔ Israel anim, na wɔdwane kokɔɔ wɔn ntomadan mu. 13Na Israelhene Yoas kyeree Ahasia ba Yehoas ba Yudahene Amasia wɔ Bet-semes; na ɔbaa Yerusalem bɛdwirii Yerusalem fasuo firi Efraim pono no ho de kɔsii ntwea pono no ho basafa ahanan. 14Na ɔfaa sika ne dwetɛ nyinaa ne nnwinneɛ a ɔhunuu no AWURADE fie, ne ahemfie akoradeɛ mu, ne nnommum pii, na ɔsane kɔɔ Samaria.
15Na Yoas ho nsɛm nkaeɛ, deɛ ɔyɛeɛ ne ne mmaninneɛ ne sɛdeɛ ɔne Yudahene Amasia koeɛ no, wɔantwerɛ no Israel Ahemfo Berɛsosɛm Nwoma no mu? 16#2 Ah 13.13 Na Yehoas tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no Samaria kaa Israel ahemfo ho, na ne ba Yeroboam bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Yuda hene Amasia wuo
(2 Berɛsosɛm 25.25-28)
17Yoas ba Yudahene Amasia tenaa ase Yehoahas ba Israelhene Yehoas wuo akyi mfirinhyia dunum. 18Na Amasia ho nsɛm nkaeɛ no, wɔatwerɛ no Yuda Ahemfo Berɛsosɛm Nwoma no mu. 19#2 Ah 12.20 Na wɔpam ne tiri so Yerusalem, na ɔdwane kɔɔ Lakis; na wɔsoma maa wɔtii no kɔɔ Lakis, na wɔkɔkumm no wɔ hɔ. 20#2 Ah 9.28 Na wɔde no too apɔnkɔ so bae, na wɔsiee no Yerusalem kaa n’agyanom ho, Dawid kuro mu.
21 # 2 Ah 15.1-2 Ɛnna Yuda man no nyinaa faa Asaria a wadi mfeɛ dunsia no na wɔsii no hene sii n’agya Amasia ananmu. 22#2 Ah 16.6 Ɔno na ɔkyekyeree Elat na ɔdane maa Yuda, na akyire yi no ɔhene no tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando.
Yeroboam a ɔtɔ so mmienu di Israel so hene
23 # 2 Ah 14.16; Hos 1.1; Amos 1.1 Yudahene Amasia, Yoas ba, afe a ɛtɔ so dunum so na Israelhene Yeroboam, Yoas ba, bɛdii hene, Samaria, na ɔdii adeɛ mfeɛ aduanan baako.
24 # 1 Ah 12.26-33 Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, wamfiri Nebat ba Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no bɔne nyinaa ho.
25 # Yona 1.1 Ɔno na ɔkɔgyee Israel hyeɛ sane maa wɔn de firi Hamat de bɛsi Araba po ano, sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn asɛm a ɔnam n’akoa Amitai ba Yona, odiyifoɔ a ɔfiri Gat-hefer so kaeɛ no. 26#Deut 32.36 Na AWURADE hunuu Israel amanehunu, sɛ ɛyɛ nwono papa, na ɔdehyeɛ ne akoa nyinaa kɔ a Israel nni ɔboafoɔ biara.
27 # 2 Ah 13.5 Nso na AWURADE nkaa sɛ ɔbɛpepa Israel din afiri ɔsoro ase, na ɔnam Yoas ba Yeroboam so gyee wɔn.
28Na Yeroboam ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa ne ne mmaninneɛ, sɛdeɛ ɔkoeɛ, ne sɛdeɛ ɔdanee Damasko ne Hamat a na ɛyɛ Yuda dea no maa Israel no, wɔantwerɛ no Israel Ahemfo Berɛsosɛm Nwoma no mu? 29#2 Ah 15.18 Na Yeroboam tii n’agyanom Israel ahemfo wɔ asamando, na ne ba Sakaria bɛdii n’adeɛ.

Ɔno na ɔkumm Edom mu nnipa mpemdu Nkyene-bonhwa mu, na ɔde ɔko faa Sela, na ɔtoo ne din Yokteel de bɛsi nnɛ.
Ɛberɛ no mu na Amasia somaa abɔfoɔ maa wɔkɔɔ Israelhene Yehu ba Yehoahas ba Yehoas nkyɛn sɛ: Bra, ma yɛnsɔ yɛn ho nhwɛ. Na wiram mmoa a wɔwɔ Lebanon no sene bɛtiatiaa nkasɛɛ dua no so. Kum deɛ woakum Edom, na w’akoma ama wo so. Ma w’animuonyam nnɔɔso mma wo na tena wo fie, na adɛn nti na wo ne mmusuo rebɛdi aperepereɛ na woahwe aseɛ, wo ne Yuda nyinaa?

Na Israelhene Yoas kyeree Ahasia ba Yehoas ba Yudahene Amasia wɔ Bet-semes; na ɔbaa Yerusalem bɛdwirii Yerusalem fasuo firi Efraim pono no ho de kɔsii ntwea pono no ho basafa ahanan. Na ɔfaa sika ne dwetɛ nyinaa ne nnwinneɛ a ɔhunuu no AWURADE fie, ne ahemfie akoradeɛ mu, ne nnommum pii, na ɔsane kɔɔ Samaria.
Na Yoas ho nsɛm nkaeɛ, deɛ ɔyɛeɛ ne ne mmaninneɛ ne sɛdeɛ ɔne Yudahene Amasia koeɛ no, wɔantwerɛ no Israel Ahemfo Berɛsosɛm Nwoma no mu? Na Yehoas tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no Samaria kaa Israel ahemfo ho, na ne ba Yeroboam bɛdii n’adeɛ.


Yoas ba Yudahene Amasia tenaa ase Yehoahas ba Israelhene Yehoas wuo akyi mfirinhyia dunum. Na Amasia ho nsɛm nkaeɛ no, wɔatwerɛ no Yuda Ahemfo Berɛsosɛm Nwoma no mu. Na wɔpam ne tiri so Yerusalem, na ɔdwane kɔɔ Lakis; na wɔsoma maa wɔtii no kɔɔ Lakis, na wɔkɔkumm no wɔ hɔ. Na wɔde no too apɔnkɔ so bae, na wɔsiee no Yerusalem kaa n’agyanom ho, Dawid kuro mu.
Ɛnna Yuda man no nyinaa faa Asaria a wadi mfeɛ dunsia no na wɔsii no hene sii n’agya Amasia ananmu. Ɔno na ɔkyekyeree Elat na ɔdane maa Yuda, na akyire yi no ɔhene no tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando.

Yudahene Amasia, Yoas ba, afe a ɛtɔ so dunum so na Israelhene Yeroboam, Yoas ba, bɛdii hene, Samaria, na ɔdii adeɛ mfeɛ aduanan baako.
Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, wamfiri Nebat ba Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no bɔne nyinaa ho.

Nso na AWURADE nkaa sɛ ɔbɛpepa Israel din afiri ɔsoro ase, na ɔnam Yoas ba Yeroboam so gyee wɔn.
Na Yeroboam ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa ne ne mmaninneɛ, sɛdeɛ ɔkoeɛ, ne sɛdeɛ ɔdanee Damasko ne Hamat a na ɛyɛ Yuda dea no maa Israel no, wɔantwerɛ no Israel Ahemfo Berɛsosɛm Nwoma no mu? Na Yeroboam tii n’agyanom Israel ahemfo wɔ asamando, na ne ba Sakaria bɛdii n’adeɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
